citation: Tones: MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8 Table 514.8D-IIIa rotor parameters (frequency formulas in Table 514.8D-IIIb; 1P 4.86 Hz, blade-pass 19.44 Hz + harmonics, tail 1T 23.60 Hz). Residual RMS: within the <25 urad RMS high-quality-gimbal class (Miller, Mooty & Hilkert, as summarized in Rodin et al. 2019, Sensors, PMC6864454).
notes: Tone weights are design assumptions; RMS is a published spec-ceiling-class figure read as per-axis RMS.
